ace.quirk: Keeps a paper maintenance ledger and ticks every line by hand.
Can't walk past a loose panel without tightening it.
Brings tea to the junior techs and quizzes them on schematics.

armory.quirk: Counts the racks twice and initials the log in green ink.
Keeps a private high-score sheet for the firing range.
Hums off-key while checking cell gauges and over-checks the door seal.

bot.quirk: Talks to the tomato vines and names each bed.
Logs every pH reading twice and distrusts sensor averages.
Keeps a hidden stash of real coffee beans in a potting shed locker.

cargo.quirk: Reads every strap tension twice and initials the manifest in green pen
Hums while hauling and stacks the lighter crates on top as a rule of thumb
Keeps a pocket of salvaged parts and rebuilds cargo sleds in spare time

carto.quirk: Re-checks every fix twice and hums while the plot renders.
Stops mid-corridor to explain a nebula to anyone nearby.
Keeps a cold mug of tea on the console and forgets it.

ce.quirk: Carries a paper checklist and initials every line
Always has a half-rebuilt injector on the workbench
Mutters to the warp core like an old dog

cfo.quirk: Reads the helm log aloud at handover, every line.
Keeps a battered coffee mug at the helm console and tells launch stories.
Would rather be flying a shuttle than managing; runs extra sim drills in the holo-playroom.

cmo.quirk: Always has a lukewarm mug of tea somewhere in sickbay and forgets where.
Re-counts the controlled-drug locker herself every shift.
Hums while working and keeps a drawer of sweets for anxious patients.

co.quirk: Reads every report to the last line
Cannot stay in the chair more than an hour
Plays solitaire chess in the ready room

comms.quirk: Reads the relay board aloud in the same order every sweep.
Knows who is feuding with whom before they do.
Keeps a half-built radio on the workshop bench.

comp.quirk: Logs every diagnostic with a timestamp and a one-line summary, even for nothing.
Keeps a private script folder of 'temporary' fixes and names them after snacks.
Re-runs a checksum three times and sleeps badly after any anomaly.

cook.quirk: Labels every tray with a ready time and checks the cold-store log twice.
Slips extra portions to anyone who looks rough and trades news for it.
Keeps a private sourdough starter and tweaks recipes against orders.

cos.quirk: Signs every locker log with the same green pen.
Knows every crew member's kid's name and uses it.
Rechecks the brig door twice before leaving.

counsel.quirk: Keeps a pot of herbal tea going in the office and offers it to everyone, including the captain.
Writes everything in a paper notebook she never lets anyone see.
Does her best listening at 0300 in the empty lounge, nursing one drink for an hour.

cso.quirk: Re-runs any calibration she did not do herself and annotates logs in the margins.
Narrates discoveries to whoever is nearby, and keeps a jar of odd sample rocks on the desk.
Runs on stewed tea and delegates to the sensor officer whenever safe.

dc.quirk: Counts every seal ring and patch kit twice and labels shelves with a grease pencil.
Keeps a deck of cards in the tool belt and always has one more hand in him.
Taps every bulkhead seal twice when passing and knows which ones lie.

deck.quirk: Reads every checklist line aloud, even alone.
Names each shuttle's squeaky hatch and talks to them.
Keeps a thermos of bad coffee hidden behind the fuel locker.

dep.quirk: Initials every log page twice and carries a paper checklist.
Always has a mug of cold tea in hand and knows everyone's birthday.
Naps in the brig office chair when no prisoners are held.

doc.quirk: Reads every chart twice and initials the margin in green ink.
Runs a low-stakes card game in the lounge and keeps a deck in the lab coat.
Checks on the same two crewmen who had bad scans last week, unprompted.

env.quirk: Logs scrubber hours in a paper notebook as a backup to the computer.
Names the circulation fans and talks to them; keeps a sprig of basil by the console.
Always has cold tea within reach and a running tally of 'things that were fine yesterday'.

eps.quirk: Logs every tap reading in a worn notebook as well as the console
Hums off-key while working and trusts his ear over the meter
Double checks every breaker twice and keeps a spare fuse in each pocket

galley.quirk: Wipes the same counter twice and logs every temperature reading.
Keeps a secret off-menu recipe and slips extra portions to tired crew.
Talks to the stockpot and swears the old recipes beat the replicators.

guard.quirk: Logs every round to the minute and salutes with a tiny nod.
Knows everyone's business from corridor chats.
Keeps tapping the stun grip to check it is holstered.

helm.quirk: Reads the thruster checklist aloud under her breath, every time.
Drums on the console edge and hums while holding a course.
Re-checks the drift log three times and keeps a paper notebook of lurches.

holo.quirk: Reads the interlock log aloud like a prayer and taps the holocube twice before leaving.
Writes his own silly scenarios on shift and tests them on himself.
Keeps a jar of replicated sweets for anyone who leaves the room in a good mood.

lab.quirk: Re-labels every vial even when the label is fine.
Rigs spare parts into odd gadgets in the workshop.
Knows everyone's gossip, trades it for coffee.

medtech.quirk: Double-checks every label aloud and wipes the tray rail twice.
Keeps a mug of cold tea on the supply cart and gets lost in crosswords.
Reads med journals on the console and over-reports minor readings.

nav.quirk: Re-derives every fix by hand before trusting the computer.
Sketches star charts on napkins and quizzes the cartographer.
Triple-checks drift figures and hums when nervous.

nurse.quirk: Initials every chart line twice and re-counts the pharmacy tray at each handover.
Knows every crew member's ailments and birthdays; keeps a tin of ginger biscuits in the desk.
Never without a mug of stew-strength tea; naps in the supply nook when quiet.

ops.quirk: Initials every checklist twice and logs coffee refills as 'consumables'.
Carries a pocket spanner and trades favours instead of filing requests.
Keeps a private tally of the bridge's 'urgent' requests that were not.

pilot.quirk: Reads the preflight card aloud even when alone.
Taps out flight patterns on any console edge.
Always has a flask of bad coffee for the deck crew.

qm.quirk: Recounts the cold store twice and writes tallies on a paper slate.
Keeps an unofficial swap shelf of favours behind the depot counter.
Hoards spare coffee beans and cannot sleep before a resupply.

reactor.quirk: Reads every log entry aloud before signing it.
Taps the core console twice before every injector check.
Hums off-key while tuning and rebuilds spare injector parts for fun.

rep.quirk: Wipes every replicator hatch twice and labels everything
Tries custom recipes on night shift and hands out samples
Talks to the machines like stubborn pets

sec.quirk: Checks the brig lock twice and signs every log line in full.
Knows everyone's name and what they drink; stops to chat on every patrol.
Cannot sleep before a quiet watch; rattles a coin across his knuckles.

sensor.quirk: Logs every calibration to four decimals and corrects people's terminology.
Keeps a private notebook of odd returns nobody asked about.
Reads sensor logs aloud as bedtime trivia at the bar.

so.quirk: Reads every handover log line aloud before signing it.
Cannot pass the mess without checking the coffee and the mood.
Keeps a pocket ledger of small faults that haven't been reported yet.

tchief.quirk: Reads the pad checklist aloud, every single time, even alone.
Keeps a deck of cards in the console drawer and a chipped mug on the pad rail.
Counts pad indicator lights twice and dreams about transport accidents.

ttech.quirk: Reads every checklist line aloud, even alone.
Keeps a shoebox of salvaged emitter coils and rebuilds them for fun.
Hums off-key while recalibrating and trades gossip at the pad.

xo.quirk: Carries a paper checklist and ticks it with a stylus nobody else may touch.
Cannot pass the mess without tasting whatever the cooks are testing.
Keeps a pocket multitool and quietly fixes sticky doors during rounds.

yeoman.quirk: Keeps snacks in the desk drawer.
